overview: Convert chosen images, audio, and video into new copies using Misty’s isolated media converter.
capabilities: Convert batches of chosen image, audio, or video files
Choose format and quality; preserve original files
Cancel pending conversions and save copies with collision-safe names
permissions: Read media chosen in the native picker
Save new copies in a folder chosen for writing
Convert chosen media in a restricted native process
getting_started: Install FFmpeg on your Mac. Isolated converters for other platforms are in development.
Open Quick Convert and choose media files and an output folder.
Choose a format and quality, then convert. Completed copies are kept when cancellation is requested.
changelog: v0.4.0 - Replaced legacy command jobs with explicit file grants and Host-owned restricted media conversion on macOS.
v0.3.0 - Moved Quick Convert into the workspace app tab with resumable job status.
v0.2.0 - Added secure conversion jobs, quality and destination controls, cancellation, and output reveal.
v0.1.0 - Initial plugin template for media conversion workflows.
